verdict.rationale: Restate documents a TypeScript testing companion library that uses Testcontainers to spin up a throwaway Restate Server in Docker for exercising handlers. It also ships as a self-contained single binary with a documented local development setup, so testing can run in an environment isolated from production. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented sandbox/staging environment concept (e.g. in Restate Cloud), testing utilities documented for SDKs beyond TypeScript, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the testing workflow.
